fitting_attempts_scope: Discovery-rule fitting only; local calibration, detrending and scaling are itemized in native validation
raw_acquisition_scope: Source files include historically exposed responses; preparation does not establish new independent test evidence
remaining_gate: Complete contracts, rights and notices; native reconstruction for remaining scenarios; new versioned admission and frozen comparison

admission_blockers: Historical CSV quote semantics absorb physical complaint records; a corrected edition and new frozen comparison are required

native_nhtsa_validation.availability_scope: DATEA equals receipt date in this frozen selection but does not prove as-issued publication, daily completeness or immutable product labels
native_nhtsa_validation.online_test_history: May counts enter June/July inputs; June counts enter July inputs; not a simultaneous three-month forecast
native_nhtsa_validation.response_scope: Unique received complaint counts, not incidence, defect probability, injuries or fleet risk

source_layout.format: 51 literal tab-delimited fields per physical record

scope: Curator-only native reconstruction of historical or corrected development drafts; passing replay does not clear reported admission blockers
